The Ollama 0.34.1 release notes indicate that the `/api/tags` endpoint became significantly faster for large model libraries. Specifically, the time taken to answer a cold request was reduced from 3.1 seconds to 294 milliseconds during testing. 

This information is found in the context provided from the document labeled "ollama/v0.34.1.md" with the line: 

"* `/api/tags` is much faster on large model libraries (3.1 s → 294 ms cold in testing), and model capabilities are now reported consistently." 

["ollama/v0.34.1.md" (lines 1-15)] 

Therefore, after the speed-up in Ollama version 0.34.1, the `/api/tags` endpoint answered a cold request in 294 milliseconds.
